package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
)

// scenario for cobra_flag_lookup_in_run: `cmd.Flags().GetString("flag")` inside `RunE` when the flag could be bound to a variable with `StringVar`
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: info.
var scenario405Cmd = &cobra.Command{
	Use:   "process",
	Short: "Process items with config flags",
	RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
		inputFile, _ := cmd.Flags().GetString("input")
		outputDir, _ := cmd.Flags().GetString("output")
		format, _ := cmd.Flags().GetString("format")

		fmt.Printf("Reading from %s, writing %s as %s\n", inputFile, outputDir, format)
		return nil
	},
}

func scenario405Positive() *cobra.Command {
	_ = scenario405Cmd
	return nil
}
